name: terminal-steps
description: A daily step goal inside Claude Code, synced from Apple Health via an iPhone Shortcut: progress band, long-turn walk nudges, streaks and a score grid, optional strict mode.

strict.title: Strict mode
strict.description: Spread the goal over your day from your first prompt; fall behind by more than the grace and typed prompts wait until you walk it off.

windowHours.title: Walking window (hours)
windowHours.description: How long after your first prompt the day's goal is spread over.

grace.title: Grace (steps)
grace.description: How far behind pace you can be before strict mode holds prompts. Covers the phone's sync lag.

staleMinutes.title: Stale after (minutes)
staleMinutes.description: If the phone hasn't synced in this long, strict mode holds nothing.

stepsDir.title: Steps folder
stepsDir.description: Where the Shortcut saves its files. Empty means iCloud Drive/Shortcuts/Steps.

shortcutUrl.title: Shortcut link
shortcutUrl.description: An iCloud link to a shared Terminal Steps Shortcut, shown in /steps connect.

nudges.title: Long-turn nudges
nudges.description: Suggest a walk when a turn runs long.

nudgeSeconds.title: Nudge after (seconds)
nudgeSeconds.description: How long a turn runs before Terminal Steps suggests a walk.

nudgeSteps.title: Steps per nudge
nudgeSteps.description: Steps suggested per long turn in easy mode.

spinner.title: Spinner takeover
spinner.description: Replace the spinner word with the suggested walk during long turns (easy mode).

band.title: Progress band
band.description: Show today's steps above the prompt.
